Hi Jack,

Sorry, you have had to chase this twice now and that is not good enough. Here is exactly where it stands.

The Bitcoin Trio pack is still not published on the store, and the only version sitting on our side carries a different price to the $478 in the email you were sent. Publishing it and setting that price is not something I can do myself, so I have put it back in front of my colleague with your email in hand and flagged it as overdue. Someone is picking it up today and will reply to you right here.

On the Thor P2, it left our Chattanooga warehouse on October 15 and is moving to Franklin on tracking ····, currently showing arrival around October 22. You can follow it here: (tracking link hidden)

Two things that may be useful while you wait. The $25 code we gave you, ····, still stands on any future order over $100. And if you would rather not wait on the trio, the single Hammer BC04 is in stock at $249, and two Thanksgiving packs are live now: the Doge + Bitcoin Duo Pack (DC06 + BC04) at $549.99 and the Hammer Mega Pack (Thor P2 + BC04 + DC06) at $899.99.

Hi Jack,

Glad you are keeping the Thor P2, and thanks for being straight with me about the code.

On the 10 percent, I have to give you an honest no, and I am sorry for it. Our promotional codes and sale emails apply to new orders only, so we cannot take them off an order that was already placed, as a refund or as credit. That holds whether the email arrived a day after you ordered or a week after. You are very welcome to use that 10 percent code at checkout on your next purchase, and the $25 code we gave you, HD-••••••, also stands on any future order over $100.

Your Thor P2 is on its way to Franklin on tracking ····, showing arrival around October 22: (tracking link hidden)

On the Bitcoin Trio, my colleague still has that one and will come back to you in this thread with the answer on the $478 pack.

Applying a promotion to an order already placed is not something I can do myself, and I am not going to pretend otherwise. What I have done is put the exception in front of Georges and Abel with the whole history, your $369 Thor P2, the 10 percent code, and the trio question you are still waiting on. They are the ones who can authorise something outside the normal rule, and a colleague is picking it up today and will reply to you right here. I am not going to promise you an outcome before they have said yes or no, because you have had enough of that from us already.

In the meantime nothing changes on your side. The T. P2 is on its way to Franklin on (number hidden), arriving around October 22, and your $25 code HD-•••••• stays valid either way.
